title: Business Central 2026 Release Wave 2 Preview Is Now Available
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (version 29.0) preview is now available for testing by customers, partners, developers, and consultants to validate solutions and report issues before production rollout.
key_points: The public preview of BC 2026 release wave 2 (version 29.0) is available for testing in non-production environments before production rollout
Developers and partners should check AL extensions, custom pages and reports, APIs, integrations, workflows and automated processes for compatibility
Suggested steps: get preview access, read the release documentation, test extensions, validate customizations, report reproducible bugs and document needed changes
Bugs and feedback go to Microsoft via the preview bugs resource at aka.ms/BCPreviewBugs
Partners with many customers can use early testing to build a repeatable upgrade-readiness process

quotes.text: Early testing can help identify potential compatibility issues before the update reaches production.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the primary benefit of testing during preview phase

quotes.text: If you work with Business Central, don't just wait for the release - use the preview period to start exploring, testing, and providing feedback.
quotes.why_it_matters: Reinforces the call to action for the BC community to actively participate in preview testing
